code:
if id -u "$USERNAME" &>/dev/null; then
    echo "User already exists, skipping"
else
    useradd -m -s /bin/bash "$USERNAME"
fi
caption: An idempotent script checks state first -- it never assumes a clean slate.

code:
if ! grep -qF -- "$(cat "$PUBKEY_FILE")" "$AUTHORIZED_KEYS"; then
    cat "$PUBKEY_FILE" >> "$AUTHORIZED_KEYS"
fi

chmod 700 "$SSH_DIR"
chmod 600 "$AUTHORIZED_KEYS"
caption: grep before appending, then fix permissions every single run.
